changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE pending_registrations (
registration_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, user_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, dob DATE,
otp_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, otp_expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, otp_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
create_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
